description: This file is a shell script for updating and managing the Zyxel device's firmware environment. It includes functions to check environment, prepare for upgrade, and handle failures, specifically tailored for Zyxel's device partitions and boot process.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure in environment check or preparation by rebooting the device.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for firmware upgrade by verifying partition info and setting boot parameters.
